cohort: Twelve pregnant women diagnosed with acute pancreatitis during pregnancy.
finding: Epidural analgesia at the L1-L2 spinal level effectively reduced pain (VAS ratings from 8-9 to 1-2) and led to faster recovery for pregnant women with acute pancreatitis, outperforming intravenous fentanyl and tramadol which never reduced VAS ratings below 3.
mod_finding: The same epidural catheter used for pain relief during acute pancreatitis was successfully reused for labor analgesia in subsequent pregnancies and for anesthesia during cesarean sections, yielding favorable outcomes.
